# Test data

## `python_oracle.json`

The cross-check table `oracle_test.go` asserts against: for a shared corpus of
patterns, flags and texts, the match spans and group spans the engine's Python
binding reports.

That binding was written against the same C ABI first, is independently
verified, and its test suite pins the exact match semantics, which makes it the
strongest oracle available to this one. A plausible-looking mistake in the
iteration or capture logic - an advance loop instead of `find_all`, a dropped
empty match, a group reported as empty rather than absent - shows up as a
disagreement with a table this package did not compute.

Generated by `python3 scripts/python_oracle.py`. Everything in it is byte
offsets. Do not edit it by hand.
